# heraut version sprint bump

Increment versioning.sprint in .heraut.yml.

Add one to versioning.sprint in .heraut.yml and write the file back. Run it at the start of each
sprint: the next release uses the new number and resets PATCH to 0.

## Usage

```text
heraut version sprint bump [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut version sprint bump
heraut version sprint bump --dry-run
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` |  | print actions without executing them |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
